description: This file defines the SecurityGroupUserRelationship class, which models the relationship between security groups and users within the application. It includes properties for storing relationship data, methods for fetching related entity details, and query construction logic.

classes.name: SecurityGroupUserRelationship
classes.description: A class extending SugarBean that manages the relationship between security groups and users, including data fields and methods for populating related data fields and creating user queries.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Fetches and populates the security group name and user name based on their respective IDs.

methods.name: create_list_query
methods.description: Constructs an SQL query to list users, optionally filtered by conditions and ordered by last and first name.
